title: Design-system project registry
description: Declares every Figma-backed design system this repo drives. Consumed by libs/altitude-mcp/src/lib/ds-project.mjs.

default.description: Project id used when neither --project nor DS_PROJECT is supplied. Must be a key of `projects`.

$brandLibraryComment.description: Free-text rationale for this project's brandLibrary (why the layer exists). Documentation only — no tool reads it.

id.description: Stable slug. Must equal the key this project is stored under.

name.description: Human-readable design-system name, used in prompts and reports.

brand.description: The `<al-theme brand>` value this project renders under. Must exist as a tier-2 brand token set.

fileKey.description: Figma file key — the canonical library file for this project.

fileName.description: Exact file name, asserted by refresh before any write.

urlBase.description: URL template. `{fileKey}` is substituted at read time.

componentPagePrefix.description: Page-name prefix marking component pages in this Figma file (e.g. the 🛠 hammer emoji). Used by the digest snapshot to skip non-component pages.

decoys.description: Look-alike files that must never be written to. refresh-figma-digests refuses to run when Figma is on one of these.

paths.description: Repo-root-relative. Only `parityManifest` is git-tracked; the rest of figmaSyncDir is ignored.

instanceMap.description: Module exporting INSTANCE_MAP / MISSING_IN_FIGMA (tag -> pinned Figma node id) for THIS project's file. Node ids are file-scoped, so a map from another project must never be applied. `null` = no pinned mappings yet; every component seeds as unmapped.

root.description: Repo-root-relative path to the component library.

components.description: OPTIONAL ALLOWLIST — the subset of the library that IS this design system. Omit to include every component in the library (Altitude's case: it is the library). When present, the parity report covers only these tags and the Storybook lists only their stories, so a design system that ships 21 of 105 components does not report the other 84 as missing from its Figma file.

excludeTitlePrefixes.description: Story-title prefixes that are NOT components of this design system, so parity does not report them as missing in Figma. SCOPE, not presentation — this lived under `storybook` until 2026-08-23, which was wrong twice: it is a library concern, and it vanished when a project's Storybook was retired.

brandLibrary.description: OPTIONAL SECOND LAYER — a library of components that belong to THIS design system alone, built on top of `library`. `library` is shared: several design systems document subsets of the same package, so nothing brand-specific may live there. A brand layer is not shared and therefore needs no `components` allowlist: every component it declares is, by construction, in scope. The docs site composes the two (apps/docs/src/lib/registry.mjs).

workspace.description: npm package name of the brand layer, e.g. `@southleft/sl-web-components`. Used to build each component's documented import path.

root.description: Repo-root-relative path to the brand layer, holding its `custom-elements.json` and `components/<slug>/<slug>.stories.ts`.

tagPrefix.description: Custom-element tag prefix, e.g. `sl-`. Distinct from `library.tagPrefix` so the two layers never collide.

supersedes.description: brand tag -> base tag. The base component stays in `library.components` (the consuming app really does use it, and parity still tracks it), but the docs site documents the brand component in its place rather than listing both under the same name. Use ONLY when the brand component is the brand's answer to that base component — e.g. a brand header built on the base header.

mcpPort.description: Port for this project's streamable-HTTP MCP + /parity.json endpoint.

productionBase.description: Deployed Storybook base URL, used to build absolute docs links in reports.

storybook.description: OPTIONAL — a project may have no Storybook at all (Southleft's was retired 2026-08-23 in favour of the docs site), so every consumer must guard its reads.

prompts.description: Values spliced into the copy-paste AI reconciliation prompt.

excluded.description: tag -> reason. Components deliberately not represented in this project's Figma file.

docs.description: Where this project's documentation is published. Added 2026-08-23, when Southleft's Storybook was retired in favour of the multi-brand docs site (apps/docs) which serves every project from the same CEM. The MCP prefers this over `storybook` when both are present.

route.description: Path segment the docs site serves this project under: '' for the default project, '/<id>' otherwise. Same value apps/docs derives in src/lib/projects.mjs.

components.description: DOCS SCOPE, decoupled from LIBRARY scope. Omit and the docs site documents `library.components` (the subset this system ships) exactly as before. Set to "all" and the docs site documents the WHOLE base library, while `library.components` keeps its own meaning untouched — it is still what Figma parity builds its list from, what scripts/check-sl-scope.mjs re-derives from the consuming site, and what scripts/check-brand-conformance.mjs treats as the project's base allowlist. The two answer different questions: `library.components` is what this design system SHIPS, `docs.components` is what its documentation SHOWS. A brand layer and its `supersedes` apply either way.

productionBase.description: Absolute URL of this project's deployed docs, no trailing slash.

theme.description: OPTIONAL theming defaults for this project's docs pages, so the docs boot on the same axes the design system's own site ships (added 2026-08-28, spec southleft-docs-parity-with-example-site R8). `defaultMode` is what a first-time visitor sees before any stored preference (omit = light, the docs default); the mode toggle still persists and overrides it. `contrast` is passed through to the `<al-theme contrast>` attribute (omit = the component default).
